name: Stair Climbing
steps: Start at the bottom of a clear flight of stairs facing the steps, with the handrail within reach.
Place one foot securely on the next tread and push through it to lift your body.
Climb continuously with alternating feet and keep your eyes on the steps ahead.
Slow as you approach the landing and step onto it before stopping or turning.
tips: Place enough of your foot on each step to keep the heel supported.
Use the rail as needed for balance without pulling yourself up by your arms.
